page.layout: One page of text in italic verse, with a running head at the top; marginal notes in the left margin (small glosses naming peoples and places); a line "Mille" at the lower right of the text block; no bottom furniture.

p.i: Inuentúmque locis omnis quem credidit ætas,
Caculus, hunc legio latè comitatur agrestis:
Quíque altum Prænestæ viri, quíque arua Gabinæ
Iunonis, gelidúmque Anienem, & roscida riuis
Hernica saxa colunt, quos diues Anagnia pascit,
Quos Amasenæ pater. Non illis omnibus arma,
Nec clypei, currúsve sonant, pars maxima glandes
Liuentis plumbi spargit: pars spicula gestat
Bina manu, sulúosque lupi de pelle galeros
Tegmen habet capiti: vestigia nuda sinistri
Instituere pedis: crudus tegit altera pero.
At Mesapus equum domitor, Neptunia proles,
Quem neque fas igni cuiquam, nec sternere ferro,
Iampridem resides populos, defuetáque bello
Agmina in arma vocat subito, ferrúmque retractat.
Hi Fescenninas acies, æquósque Falisco,
Hi Soractis habent arces, Flaminiáque arua,
Et Cymini cum monte lacum, lucósque Capenos.
Ibant æquati numero, regémque canebant.
Ecce Sabinorum prisco de sanguine magnum
Agmen agens Claufus, magnique ipse agminis instar,
Claudia nunc à quo diffunditur, & tribus, & gens
Per Latium, postquam in partem data Roma Sabinis:
Vnâ ingens Amiterna cohors, prisque Quirites,
Ereti manus omnis, oliuiferaq; Mutuscæ:
Qui Nomentum urbem, qui Rosea rura Velini,
Qui Tetricæ horrentes rupes, montémque Seuerum,
Casperiámque colunt, Forulósque, & flumen Himellæ:
Qui Tiberim, Fabarímque bibunt, quos frigida misit
Nursia & Hortina classes, populíque Latini:
Quósque secans infaustum interluit Allia nomen.
Hinc Agamemnonius, Troiani nominis hostis,
Curru iungit Halesus equos, Turnóque feroces,
Mille

page.notes: The marginal notes are set in small type and their line-to-line alignment with the verse is approximate; the left margin notes are transcribed in order from top to bottom. Some letters in the Greek-style and italic text are doubtful, notably in "Claudia", "Nursia" and "Soractis". Passage line numbers are not printed.
